# A test's read of a node's prop is the value the node is drawn with, so what
# it reads of a context is the value of the provider the node is mounted
# beneath -- one in the instance's own body, or one around the call site of an
# instance on the way to it -- and the test's own value only where no provider
# stands between the test's instance and the node. A test is a root: what it
# reads itself, and what a func it calls reads, is its own.
#
# The read is the expression the node's call site gave, read through the
# instance (design/testing.md), and the compiled targets read its context
# where the test stands: `c.inside.label.value` read the test's "plain", so
# a page's words read in English after a test chose French above them.
# context_through_slot.txt is the same claim for the interpreter alone.

sngl test --platform=none app.sngl
stdout 'ok +3 tests, 0 failures'
sngl test --platform=html app.sngl
stdout 'ok +3 tests, 0 failures'
sngl test --platform=bubbletea --language=go app.sngl
stdout 'ok +3 tests, 0 failures'
sngl test --platform=fyne --language=go app.sngl
stdout 'ok +3 tests, 0 failures'
sngl test --platform=gtk4 --language=go app.sngl
stdout 'ok +3 tests, 0 failures'
sngl test --platform=android --language=kotlin app.sngl
stdout 'ok +3 tests, 0 failures'

-- app.sngl --
import test "sngl:test"
import ui "sngl:ui"

context #tone("plain")

func said(s string) => tone == "plain" ? s : "{s} ({tone})"

component leaf ui.node {
    ui.text #label(value=said("hi"))
}

// A leaf under a provider of its own body's, and one under none.
component pair ui.node {
    tone("soft") {
        leaf #near
    }
    leaf #far
}

component probe ui.node {
    var picked = "loud"

    ui.select #pick(:value=picked) {
        ui.choice(label="loud")
        ui.choice(label="quiet")
    }
    tone(picked) {
        leaf #inside
        ui.text #own(value=said("yo"))
    }
    leaf #outside
    pair #both
}

func testAReadIsUnderTheProviderAroundTheNode(t test.Test, c probe) {
    t.assert(c.own.value == "yo (loud)")
    t.assert(c.inside.label.value == "hi (loud)")
    t.assert(c.outside.label.value == "hi")
    t.assert(c.both.near.label.value == "hi (soft)")
    t.assert(c.both.far.label.value == "hi")
}

func testAReadFollowsTheProvidersValue(t test.Test, c probe) {
    c.pick.change("quiet")
    t.assert(c.picked == "quiet")
    t.assert(c.own.value == "yo (quiet)")
    t.assert(c.inside.label.value == "hi (quiet)")
}

// The test's own value is a provider around the test's instance, and over
// what the test reads itself.
func testATestsValueIsUnderNoProvider(t test.Test, c probe) {
    t.setContext(tone, "dim")
    t.assert(said("hey") == "hey (dim)")
    t.assert(c.outside.label.value == "hi (dim)")
    t.assert(c.both.far.label.value == "hi (dim)")
    t.assert(c.inside.label.value == "hi (loud)")
}

ui.window {
    probe()
}
